Subject: Venue walk + AV staging requirements for Sept 14-15 exec workshop

Hi Sophie / AV team —

We're evaluating the level 2 ballroom at Marriott CityCenter for our executive workshop on Sept 14-15. High level requirements: hybrid keynote (200 in-room, 80 remote), two breakout rooms with simultaneous livestreams, a control room for camera switcher + AV engineer, and at least two redundant bridges for remote participants.

Attached: initial floorplan and our rough AV equipment wish-list. Can we schedule a site walk this week? Key items we need to confirm in person: power access behind stage, ceiling camera sightlines, dedicated network handoff (we prefer a private VLAN to our bridge), and a separate comms room for encoders.

Please include a preliminary quote for single-point failure mitigation (redundant encoder + backup bridge) and any known codec/bridge compatibility notes.

Markus and Laura are copied for logistics and travel constraints.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Events & Executive Programs
Redwood Inference

Hi team —

Thanks for including us. We can do the walkthrough Wednesday 8/18 at 2pm (confirmed). After an initial review of your equipment list, here are the high-level notes we intend to validate on-site: 

- Primary signal path: 3x PTZ cameras (NDI + SDI redundant feed), Blackmagic ATEM switcher (main program + aux), redundant hardware encoder (SRT out + RTMP fallback), and an audio snake to FOH console with AES42 feed to encoder.
- Network: We recommend a dedicated /29 for the AV stack; we'll bring a small managed switch and a cellular backup (4G/5G bonding) for bridge failover.
- Bridging: We support Zoom, Teams, and our hosted SRT gateway for large concurrent remote viewers. For M+28 attendee counts we suggest a primary bridge on Zoom + a standby Teams link to reduce single-vendor risk.
- Power & redundancy: We'll require access to the 400A distro for stage power and will bring an inline UPS for the control rack.

We'll produce a line-item quote (attachment) after the walkthrough and include suggested callouts for your vendor agreement (insurance limits, hold harmless, and load-in window).

--

Thanks for confirming the walkthrough and the initial notes — Eduardo, Sophie. A couple of technical clarifications from the product/infra side before we meet: 

1) Codec & stream harmonization: Our internal expectation is to ingest a single SRT (or RTMP with consistent metadata) into Redwood's relay pool. If AVPro's primary path is NDI inside the venue plus SDI out to a hardware encoder, we just need the encoder config (SRT with AES-128) and a confirmed public IP/port mapping. Please include exact encoder models in the quote.

2) Access & network handoff: We plan to terminate the VLAN at our cloud-managed router on-site (we'll bring a Meraki MX68). Please confirm Marriott can provide an unfiltered handoff (no outbound NAT in the hotel firewall) for the /29 block. If hotel policy prevents that, we will fall back to a secure outbound tunnel to our cloud relay and will need consistent egress bandwidth (recommended 80 Mbps sustained during keynotes).

3) Backup bridge choreography: Recommend a primary Zoom webinar (hosted by AVPro) and a standby Teams meeting (managed by our internal ops). In a failover, we will swap DNS on our edge relay to point to the standby bridge. AVPro: please enumerate any expected failover latency (seconds) for switching encoders/bridges.

4) On-call staffing: We'll need one Redwood engineer on-site during rehearsals and the first day of the event — Laura will handle travel if dates are confirmed.

Look forward to reviewing site notes in person.

-Markus
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com

Markus / team —

Following the walkthrough: attached is our line-item quote (av_quote_v1.pdf) and an equipment spreadsheet (av_equipment_list.xlsx). Highlights: 

- Encoder models: Haivision Makito X6 (primary) with Haivision Makito X4 as hot standby. Both support SRT with AES-128 and RTMP fallback.
- Expected failover: hardware switchover between primary and standby encoder is ~3-5s if configured with identical stream targets. Bridge-level failover (Zoom -> Teams) depends on listener reconnection and can be 6-20s depending on client reconnection behavior.
- Network needs: recommend 100 Mbps committed egress for the keynote to account for multiple inbound gallery/recording feeds and headroom. Our cellular-bonding fallback expects at least 20 Mbps aggregated to be effective.
- Pricing: redundancy package (dual encoders + cellular bond + tech staff) estimate $12,400 excl. tax. Line items called out in quote.

We flagged two items that need contract attention: venue load-in after 1800 requires an overtime fee with the house; and a request for an unfiltered handoff will require an addendum to the standard network use agreement.

--
Eduardo Ruiz
Lead Systems Engineer, AVPro Rentals
